status: exploratory: not pre-registered, one repetition, not evidence for a research question (R6.2, R6.3)
repository_commit: 1d70b48 (creusot-examples, with that commit's changes uncommitted at the time) and d43f4a1 (creusat)
method: eval/scripts/corpus_hardness.py with DP_MATRIX_SECONDS=5: dp-frontend (release) proves every file from scratch with the project's why3find.json and, for every goal that gets a prover call, also runs every prover alone at a reference limit of 5 s; eval/scripts/prover_matrix.py classifies the goals

runs.creusot-examples: the 27 Coma files of examples/ of Creusot v0.15.0 (fd4d85b2); summary in creusot-examples/matrix/summary.json, the goals that the first prover does not prove in creusot-examples/matrix/hard.jsonl
runs.creusat: the 143 Coma files of verif/ of CreuSAT (232edff0), proved with the project's why3find.json; summary in creusat/matrix/summary.json, the goals that the first prover does not prove in creusat/matrix/hard.jsonl

caveats: tests, Creusot proofs and model checking ran on the machine during the creusot-examples measurement, and tests during part of the creusat one, so times are noisy and some outcomes near the 5 s limit may be timeouts that a quiet machine would not have
a goal is every node of a proof tree that got a prover call: leaves and the goals that a tactic then split
the order of the provers is the order of the project's why3find.json; the order in which why3find calls them was not checked against it
examples/persistent_array.coma ended with status 2 once in the batch and was measured again; the cause is not known (runs.jsonl keeps both lines)

findings.creusot-examples: 2179 goals; the first prover (alt-ergo) proves 1883 alone, a later prover 224 more, no single prover 72; time to the first proof with the provers in order 2446 s, with the fastest prover of each goal 280 s
findings.creusat: 748 goals; the first prover proves 715 alone, a later prover 24 more, no single prover 9; in order 259 s, fastest prover 38 s; no file failed
findings.reading: the goals that the first prover does not prove (296 and 33) are where a race of the provers can save time; the times are prover time on one machine and say nothing yet about a Cluster
